inicio.titulo: A church by the river, with open doors
inicio.subtitulo: We are a family of faith in Hatillo de Savegre. Costa Ricans and people from abroad gather here, in English and in Spanish, to know Jesus, share meals, and serve our community.
inicio.lema_texto: For by grace you have been saved through faith, and that not of yourselves; it is the gift of God, not of works, that no one would boast. For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared before that we would walk in them.

horarios.nota: Every service includes live interpretation: the sermon may be in English or in Spanish, and it is always interpreted into the other language. Visiting for the first time? Send us a message and we'll be glad to welcome you.
horarios.lugar: Hatillo de Savegre, 100 m northeast of Santa Marta School

nosotros.p1: River of Grace Church was born in Hatillo, a small town between the mountains and the Savegre River on Costa Rica's southern Pacific coast. Some of us have lived here all our lives; others came from abroad, and more than half of our church family speaks English. That's why we do everything in both languages, and neither one is an afterthought.
nosotros.p2: For us, the church isn't the building, although we have one and take good care of it. The church is the people. We don't believe there is only one format: like the first church, we gather in homes, around a table, or walking together. Preaching and songs matter, but faith is lived on Monday too.
nosotros.historia: It all began in November 2019 as the Hatillo Mission Project, in an old house we were renting. The pandemic arrived soon after and, through many difficulties, we kept meeting and proclaiming that we are saved by God's grace. It wasn't always a welcome message, and there were lonely seasons; but little by little people joined who believed it and lived it, and we began to see the fruit in their lives and in their families.
nosotros.historia2: From the very beginning, First Baptist Church of Edom, Texas, has walked alongside us. They took an interest in Hatillo and the surrounding communities and built the building where we meet today. Today we are a family with people from Costa Rica, Nicaragua, South Africa, Canada and the United States, and we hold on to the same conviction: the gospel is not only a message, it is also action. We believe that, through his church, Christ can give a real embrace to those who need it.

creencias.intro: We'd rather not be defined by labels, but by Jesus. In a few words, this is what we believe and how we try to live it.
creencias.gracia_p: We are saved by God's grace alone, through faith in Christ, not by our own works. And precisely because that grace has reached us, we walk in the good works God prepared in advance and let his Spirit grow his fruit in us. With the Church through the ages we affirm that salvation is by grace alone, through faith alone, in Christ alone, according to Scripture alone, for the glory of God alone.
creencias.dios_p: We believe in one God: Father, Son and Holy Spirit. We believe Jesus died for us and rose again, and that he will return. That hope carries us through good days and hard ones.
creencias.espiritu_p: We believe in the work of the Holy Spirit and in his gifts. We practice them simply, soberly and in good order, to build others up rather than to put on a show.
creencias.humildad_t: Firm on the essentials, humble on the rest
creencias.humildad_p: There are core truths we share with Christians from many traditions. Where Scripture doesn't give a clear answer, we choose humility: no one has the final word on everything, and we can love each other even when we see things differently.
creencias.libertad_p: Christ calls us to a free life: not to stay bound by sin, nor to carry rigid rules he never gave. Free to love God and to serve others.
creencias.mas: Read our mission, values and documents

comunidad.intro: We believe God's love shows up in practical ways. That's why serving Hatillo and the surrounding towns is at the heart of our church.
comunidad.ayuda_p: All year round we walk alongside local families with food, health care, clothing and, above all, friendship. We do it quietly, because every person deserves to be treated with dignity.
comunidad.festival_p: Since 2021, every December we fill Hatillo's town square with music, gifts and joy for around 200 children from Hatillo and Dos Bocas. It's one of the most beautiful days of the year for our community.
comunidad.dsl_t: Partnership with From Silence to Freedom
comunidad.dsl_p: Del Silencio a la Libertad (From Silence to Freedom) is an association in Costa Rica with legal backing in the United States. Text about its work and why we believe this partnership is needed: to be confirmed with Juan before publishing.
comunidad.misiones_p: We gladly welcome sister churches and mission teams, like First Baptist Church of Edom (Texas) and Cornerstone Church, who come to serve shoulder to shoulder with us. Every visit leaves friendships that last for years.

formacion.glomos_p: Together with Global Action we offer Glomos, a theological training program. It's open to leaders and members of other churches in the area, because what we learn is meant to be shared.
formacion.estudios_p: We open the Bible together in a simple way. You don't need to know much: just bring your questions and a desire to learn.

visita.direccion: Hatillo, Savegre, Quepos, Puntarenas, Costa Rica. 100 m northeast of Santa Marta School (Escuela Santa Marta).
visita.mapa_titulo: Map showing the location of River of Grace Church in Hatillo
visita.esperar_t: What to expect on your first visit
visita.esperar_1: Someone will greet you at the door, in English or in Spanish.
visita.esperar_2: Come as you are: nobody here cares what you wear.
visita.esperar_3: We sing, pray and listen to God's Word. Sermons are interpreted live: sometimes preached in English and sometimes in Spanish, always translated into the other language.
visita.esperar_4: There's almost always coffee and something to share afterwards. Stay and chat.
visita.foto_alt: Front of River of Grace Church's blue building, with the service sign in Spanish and English

colabora.intro: There are many ways to be part of what God is doing in Hatillo.
colabora.orar_p: Send us a message and we'll share what we're praying for: families, projects and our community.
colabora.servir_p: If your church or team would like to visit and serve, we'd love to plan it together.
colabora.dar_p: We are finishing the paperwork to open the association's bank accounts. In the meantime, if you'd like to support one of our projects, send us a message and we'll gladly tell you how.

contacto.intro: Have a question, need prayer, or want to visit? We'd love to hear from you.

asociacion.intro: River of Grace Church is legally registered in Costa Rica as the Río de Gracia Association (Asociación Río de Gracia). Here we share openly who we are, where we're headed and how we are organized.
asociacion.mision_p: To be a living community of believers, rooted in God's Word and in the faith the Church has confessed through the centuries, that exalts God by proclaiming the gospel, loving one another, growing in biblical training and serving society in practical ways.
asociacion.vision_p: To be a beacon of light and hope in Hatillo and the surrounding area, guiding people toward a life transformed by the love of Christ.
asociacion.areas_t: Four ways we live out our mission
asociacion.evangelio_p: We share the good news of Jesus with everyone, whatever their social standing, culture or beliefs. We walk with those taking their first steps of faith and strengthen fellow believers through faithful teaching of the Word.
asociacion.amor_p: We cultivate a culture of warmth, respect, unity and mutual support. We aim to speak honestly, be transparent and forgive, reflecting Christ's character in everyday life.
asociacion.formacion_t: Growing in the knowledge of God
asociacion.formacion_p: We are committed to keep learning about God and his Word, through serious study and practical application. We want to raise up leaders who are full of integrity, mature, compassionate and filled with the Holy Spirit.
asociacion.servicio_p: We mobilize as a body to meet concrete needs: food, health, clothing and spiritual care. We also support other local churches with resources, training and encouragement. Our faith is expressed in action.
asociacion.v1_p: The Bible is God's inspired Word, sufficient and authoritative to guide our faith, our lives and our mission.
asociacion.v2_p: Salvation is an undeserved gift we receive by grace alone, through faith in Jesus Christ. All we are and do is by his grace, and we live with gratitude.
asociacion.v3_p: We are the body of Christ. We build each other up through genuine friendship, accountability and spiritual support.
asociacion.v4_p: We love God with all we are and our neighbor with concrete actions: compassion, justice and truth.
asociacion.v5_p: We serve with integrity, responsibility and our very best, knowing that we do it for the Lord.
asociacion.o1_p: Develop creative, Bible-faithful ways to share the gospel with people of every culture, age and background.
asociacion.o2_p: Strengthen spiritual formation through Bible studies, discipleship groups, theological training and a culture of continual growth.
asociacion.o3_p: Lead social outreach that responds to real needs in our community: food, health, clothing and care.
asociacion.o4_p: Equip men and women to lead with humility, wisdom and biblical conviction, committed to the mission of God's Kingdom.

asociacion.proteccion_p: Protecting every child in our care is a priority. Among other things, our policy requires:
asociacion.proteccion_1: Background checks, references and a personal interview for everyone who serves with children on a regular basis.
asociacion.proteccion_2: Abuse-prevention training (Darkness to Light) for teachers and volunteers.
asociacion.proteccion_3: Two adults present whenever possible; no adult alone with a child behind closed doors or out of sight.
asociacion.proteccion_4: Any suspicion is reported to leadership and to the authorities (911). We don't wait for proof to act.
asociacion.estatutos_p: Bylaws, legal standing certificate or other documents the board decides to publish: pending.
asociacion.invitacion_p: The Río de Gracia Association opens its doors to all who share this vision of exalting God, loving our neighbor and seeing lives transformed. We invite you to be part of what God is doing in our community.
